messages.author: 26ea1959f5579e06
messages.subject: help upgrading an old broken ggplot2 script (worked in 2011)
parts:
I have a script I was using five years ago that I would like to get working again.... I'm at a bit of a loss how to do this.

I get tons of errors, the first being:
Error in eval(expr, envir, enclos) : could not find function "windows"
which my firend google has not been able to help me solve.  Not that I am a noob to R (trial and error level)

Here's the code, I was hoping someone would be able to point out some of the obvious changes/deprecations? Thanks!

library(ggplot2)
polls <- read.csv("Polls2011b.csv", header=TRUE)
election <- read.csv("Election2008.csv", header=TRUE)
election2 <- read.csv("Election2011.csv", header=TRUE)
windows(width = 8, height = 5)
ggplot(polls, aes(x = Date, y = Popular_Support, colour=Party, size=Error, weight=Error)) +
scale_area(to = c(0,3), legend=F) +
#scale_shape(solid=FALSE)+
geom_point() +
#geom_pointrange(aes(ymin=Min, ymax=Max)) +
stat_smooth(span = .4) + 
scale_colour_manual(values = c(Conservative=alpha("blue",1),Liberal=alpha("red",1),NDP=alpha("orange",1), Green=alpha("green3",1),Bloc=alpha("turquoise4", 1))) +
geom_point(data=election2, size=3, shape=5, legend=F) +
geom_point(data=election2, legend=F) +
geom_text(data=election2, legend=F, aes(label = c(39.6,18.9,30.6,"6.0",3.9)), size=3, hjust=-0.3, vjust=-0.2)+
geom_point(data=election, size=3, shape=5, legend=F) +
geom_point(data=election, legend=F) +
geom_text(data=election, legend=F, aes(label = c(37.6,26.2,18.2,"10.0",6.8)), size=3, hjust=-0.3, vjust=-0.2)+
#scale_x_date(format="%d-%b", major="4 days", minor="1 day", lim = c(as.Date("2011-03-24"), as.Date("2011-05-02"))) +
scale_x_continuous(name = "Date", limits=c(40625,40666), breaks=c(40625, 40629, 40633, 40637, 40641, 40645, 40649, 40653, 40657, 40661, 40665), labels=c('14 Oct 08\nElection', '27 Mar  11', '31 Mar 11', '4 Apr 11', '8 Apr 11', '12 Apr 11', '16 Apr 11', '20 Apr 11', '24 Apr 11', '28 Apr 11', '2 May 11\nElection')) +
scale_y_continuous(name = "% Popular Support", lim=c(0,50), expand=c(0,0)) +
opts(axis.text.x = theme_text(size = 9, angle = 90))+
opts(axis.title.x = theme_text(size = 8))+
opts(axis.text.y = theme_text(size = 10))+
opts(axis.title.y = theme_text(size = 10, angle = 90))

messages.subject: Re: help upgrading an old broken ggplot2 script (worked in 2011)
parts:
I'd recommend:

1. Use indenting and whitespace to make the structure of your code more clear.

2. If you want help from other people, make it easier for them to run
your code. We don't have Polls2011b.csv etc.

3. Rather than struggling to get the whole plot working at once, start
simple. Does

ggplot(polls, aes(x = Date, y = Popular_Support, colour=Party,
size=Error, weight=Error)) +
